scope: All 56 residual live v019 ispoln- completion/fulfilment/execution forms.
choice: Normalize the eight observed ispoln- forms by exact root substitution to the official standard izpoln- paradigm, joining 129 already-correct edition forms.
motivation: The official type-1 family is izpȯlniti/izpȯlnjati/izpȯlnjeńje, rendered in the edition's standard orthography as izpoln-. The inherited ispoln- forms are a Russian-shaped spelling layer with no semantic distinction.
alternatives_rejected: Retain ispoln- as stylistic variation; it clusters by source and conflicts with the official headword family.
Recast each occurrence with izvršiti, realizovati, or završiti; the contexts already use the correct fulfil/execute semantics and need morphology, not semantic rewriting.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
